title: Braze | Senior Platform Software Engineer II — Curated shortlist
intro: Four targeted former-Grubhub engineering introductions for Braze's Senior Platform Software Engineer II opening in New York City. The role covers internal infrastructure-as-a-service, Kubernetes automation, distributed job processing, and reliability. Candidate technical depth, current interest, and NYC office feasibility require confirmation. These profiles are separate from the public open-to-work directory.

items.note: John Burns: JVM platform tooling, Gradle, developer enablement and shared engineering frameworks. Referrer reports recent Netflix layoff. Validate Kubernetes operators, Ruby/Sidekiq, and job-processing framework ownership.

Jesus Alonso (Jeezus): Java/Kotlin services, Kafka (~12k events/second in prior integration), asynchronous workloads, Cassandra optimization, build automation. Validate Kubernetes operators and Ruby/Sidekiq.
Lonnie Baldwin: runtime engineering, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, observability and infrastructure automation. Validate recent hands-on distributed application framework development.

Engineering leader with experience in cloud infrastructure, backend systems, GitOps, Kubernetes, Terraform and distributed systems. LinkedIn profile reports supporting 40 services and 300+ AWS Lambda functions. Validate current hands-on IC interest and job-framework experience.
